view_chain: DOCX -> native OFD -> PDF -> macOS Preview
default_view_chain: DOCX -> default OFD -> PDF -> macOS Preview
reviewer: gpt-6.1-terra (High reasoning, AI visual reviewer; not human sign-off)

release_profile.scope: F01 only: fixed sample, explicit Native and default Native, two pages each.
release_profile.visual_environment: macOS 26.6.2 (25G83); actual Preview plus independent Poppler 26.09.0 PNG review at 144 dpi.
release_profile.functional_result: Both modes preserve 189 non-whitespace source characters in OFD and PDF with no duplicate PDF text. Seven physical Bold text objects and three blue table fills; selected CJK subset outlines match pinned faces.

known_limitations: This strict physical font profile does not retest Regular-only TextStroke. The separate PR108 fix applies to this SDK’s OFD-to-PDF and OFD-to-image output; the historical preview.10 failure remains historical.
Preview Find compatibility and raw Unicode Copy were not verified in this review.
This acceptance does not establish arbitrary Word fidelity or cross-renderer compatibility.
publication_status: Local candidate visual record only; no tag, GitHub Release or public NuGet publication.
